decision.explanation: The source document (pmid-27032107) is a prospective phase II study evaluating first-line erlotinib in Caucasian patients with advanced lung adenocarcinoma carrying a somatic EGFR mutation. The study explicitly identifies the p.Leu858Arg (L858R) mutation as one of the detected mutations, found in 15 patients. The authors conclude that erlotinib was 'well tolerated and highly effective in the majority of the patients' with somatic EGFR mutations. This directly supports the claim that erlotinib is predictive of sensitivity/response in Lung Adenocarcinoma with somatic EGFR L858R. The claim is fully evidenced as written.
